confidence_notes: Citywide food prices come from 2026 indexes; cocktail and 0.1 L wine prices use one local hotel bar menu. Accommodation is a broad model estimate with limited precision because spa-season demand and hostel supply vary.
comparable_city_reasoning: Accommodation is modeled on smaller Czech regional tourist and spa cities, with an allowance for Karlovy Vary's spa tourism; food and drink are anchored to citywide price indexes and a local menu.
